title: Patch: set watermarks behind every card's rules text, one for each set
notes: Every face with a rules box (any type, Radiant, Chinese, blank) prints its set's mark (R503) large, centred and faint in one ink under the text; a full-art card's goes behind its Full text and detail rules. Glitch, compact, full-art, sub-150 px, face-down and symbol-less sets (Boss, Boss-X, Custom) print none. Meditative+ gets a mark (the ensō with a plus). A Set watermarks switch (Visuals, on by default, device only) removes them (R2718000). How cards look only: nothing plays differently.

player.title: Set watermarks
changes: Every card now shows its set's symbol, faint, behind its text, and Meditative+ has a symbol of its own. Turn it off under Settings, Visuals, Set watermarks.
